svg.aria-label: How to write 学: 8 strokes · 7 pen lifts · 8 movements
svg.title: Writing 学
svg.desc: 8 frames; frame N shows movements 1 to N of 学 (chinese), the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansSC-Subset.ttf. Stroke order after Hanzi Writer Data 学.json, ordered stroke paths and medians 1–8 (Hanzi Writer Data snapshot 68d10a4, updated from Make Me a Hanzi, 22 June 2019) <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data/68d10a4b21150cae5e1ebbd223eed289cf32d90c/data/%E5%AD%A6.json>. Source note on variation: The cited PRC-order dataset supplies eight ordered strokes for 学. Medians 1–3 make the three top marks, medians 4–5 make the cover, and medians 6–8 complete 子 below. This learner path preserves that top-to-bottom grouping, the joined hooks, and seven intervening pen lifts while adapting the paths to the vendored Noto Sans SC outline.
